title: Smooth affine homotopy H(ι(t,x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) on ℝ × ℝ^N and its derivative
statement: For all N, N' ∈ ℕ and all C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) maps F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} there is a C^∞ map H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} with the following properties. Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1), Jv := ι(0, v) and D := fderiv ℝ. Then for all t ∈ ℝ and x, v ∈ ℝ^N: (i) H(ι(t, x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)); (ii) DH(ι(t, x))e₀ = G(x) − F(x); (iii) DH(ι(t, x))(Jv) = DF(x)v + t(DG(x)v − DF(x)v).
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N'), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → ∃ H : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N', ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) H ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = F x + t • (G x - F x)) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) = G x - F x) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x v : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v))) = fderiv ℝ F x v + t • (fderiv ℝ G x v - fderiv ℝ F x v)
